name.description: Name in the layer list and legend.
name.markdownDescription: Name in the layer list and legend.

group.description: Groups layers under one header in the layer list.
group.markdownDescription: Groups layers under one header in the layer list.

minZoom.description: Zoom at which the layer starts to draw. Not the camera's `map.minZoom`.
minZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom at which the layer starts to draw. Not the camera's `map.minZoom`.

maxZoom.description: Zoom at which the layer stops drawing.
maxZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom at which the layer stops drawing.

actions.description: Override which row-menu items this layer shows.
actions.markdownDescription:
Override which row-menu items this layer shows.

Default: widgets["layer-list"].actions

geometryType.description: Sets the legend swatch shape and which sublayers are built. Omit for mixed geometry. PMTiles detects it from the archive's tilestats when omitted.
geometryType.markdownDescription: Sets the legend swatch shape and which sublayers are built. Omit for mixed geometry. PMTiles detects it from the archive's tilestats when omitted.

hideFromLegend.description: Keep it on the map and in the layer list, but out of the legend.
hideFromLegend.markdownDescription:
Keep it on the map and in the layer list, but out of the legend.

Default: `false`

legend.description: How it shows in the legend. Wins over a raw symbology's `legend`, and lets layers with no kit symbology (rasters, service-styled Esri) appear.
legend.markdownDescription:
How it shows in the legend. Wins over a raw symbology's `legend`, and lets layers with no kit symbology (rasters, service-styled Esri) appear.

Default: derived from the symbology

duckdb.description: Read the file with DuckDB instead of MapLibre. On its own it isn't faster. Use it to query the layer with SQL, or with `{ "mvt": true }` to draw a large file as vector tiles cut on demand (see the GeoParquet `mvt` field). Downloads DuckDB (about 11.5 MB) at startup.

mvt.description: Draw as vector tiles cut on demand from an in-memory table.
mvt.markdownDescription:
Draw as vector tiles cut on demand from an in-memory table.

Default: `false`

maxTileFeatures.description: With `mvt`: most features per tile. The smallest are dropped first.
maxTileFeatures.markdownDescription:
With `mvt`: most features per tile. The smallest are dropped first.

Default: `5000`

maxTileZoom.description: With `mvt`: highest zoom tiles are cut at. MapLibre keeps drawing past it.
maxTileZoom.markdownDescription:
With `mvt`: highest zoom tiles are cut at. MapLibre keeps drawing past it.

Default: `14`

duckdb.markdownDescription:
Read the file with DuckDB instead of MapLibre. On its own it isn't faster. Use it to query the layer with SQL, or with `{ "mvt": true }` to draw a large file as vector tiles cut on demand (see the GeoParquet `mvt` field). Downloads DuckDB (about 11.5 MB) at startup.

Default: `false`

label.markdownDescription:

popup.markdownDescription:

visible.markdownDescription:

maxZoom.markdownDescription: Default: the archive's own zoom range for this layer

items.description: One layer inside a tile source. Unset labels and popup fall back to the archive layer's own, and an unset `symbology` draws an automatic color.

[Docs](https://conness-gis.com/configuration/adding-layers/#pmtiles)

sourceLayers.markdownDescription:
Which source layers to draw, in draw order (first on top), each with its own style. Omit (or `[]`) to draw every source layer the tiles list, in automatic colors. One entry shows as a normal layer under the layer's name. Two or more show as an expandable row in the layer list.

Default: every source layer

collapsed.description: Start the expandable row collapsed in the layer list. Only with 2+ source layers.
collapsed.markdownDescription:
Start the expandable row collapsed in the layer list. Only with 2+ source layers.

Default: `true`

encoding.markdownDescription:
Tile format. `"mlt"` is MapLibre Tiles.

Default: "mvt" (or what a TileJSON says)

How it shows in the legend. Wins over a raw symbology's `legend`, and lets layers with no kit symbology (rasters, service-styled Esri) appear.

Default: derived from the symbology

limit.description: Stop after this many features. There's no viewport filtering, so use it on big files.
limit.markdownDescription:
Stop after this many features. There's no viewport filtering, so use it on big files.

Default: no limit

mvt.description: Draw as vector tiles cut on demand by DuckDB from an in-memory copy, instead of one GeoJSON source. For large files. Starts at zoom 10 unless `minZoom` says otherwise.
mvt.markdownDescription:
Draw as vector tiles cut on demand by DuckDB from an in-memory copy, instead of one GeoJSON source. For large files. Starts at zoom 10 unless `minZoom` says otherwise.

Default: `false`

maxTileFeatures.description: With `mvt`: most features per tile. The smallest are dropped first.
maxTileFeatures.markdownDescription:
With `mvt`: most features per tile. The smallest are dropped first.

Default: `5000`

maxTileZoom.description: With `mvt`: highest zoom tiles are cut at. MapLibre keeps drawing past it. Raise it for very dense data that's still thinned at 14. Lower it for coarse data.
maxTileZoom.markdownDescription:
With `mvt`: highest zoom tiles are cut at. MapLibre keeps drawing past it. Raise it for very dense data that's still thinned at 14. Lower it for coarse data.

Default: `14`

items.description: One data layer. `type` picks the loader.
items.markdownDescription:
One data layer. `type` picks the loader.

[Docs](https://conness-gis.com/configuration/adding-layers/)

layers.description: The project's data layers (`layers.json`). Array order is draw order: first on top.
layers.markdownDescription:
The project's data layers (`layers.json`). Array order is draw order: first on top.

[Docs](https://conness-gis.com/configuration/adding-layers/)

strokeColor.description: Dot ring or polygon border color.
strokeColor.markdownDescription:
Dot ring or polygon border color.

Default: `"#ffffff"`

strokeWidth.description: Dot ring or polygon border width. 0 = none.
strokeWidth.markdownDescription:
Dot ring or polygon border width. 0 = none.

Default: 1 for points, 0 for polygons

opacity.description: Opacity of `color` (polygon fill, dot fill, the line itself), 0 to 1.
opacity.markdownDescription:
Opacity of `color` (polygon fill, dot fill, the line itself), 0 to 1.

Default: `1`

strokeOpacity.description: Opacity of `strokeColor` (dot ring, polygon border), 0 to 1. Lines have no stroke.
strokeOpacity.markdownDescription:
Opacity of `strokeColor` (dot ring, polygon border), 0 to 1. Lines have no stroke.

Default: `1`

oneOf.description: One color plus a few paint options. Meaning depends on geometry: point = dot and ring, line = line, polygon = fill and border.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
One color plus a few paint options. Meaning depends on geometry: point = dot and ring, line = line, polygon = fill and border.

paint.description: MapLibre paint properties, e.g. `"circle-color"`. Expressions allowed.
paint.markdownDescription: MapLibre paint properties, e.g. `"circle-color"`. Expressions allowed.

legend.description: Explicit legend. Omit to read it from `paint`.
legend.markdownDescription: Explicit legend. Omit to read it from `paint`.

description.description: Muted note under the layer name in the legend, e.g. `"Annual passengers"`.
description.markdownDescription: Muted note under the layer name in the legend, e.g. `"Annual passengers"`.

oneOf.description: A raw MapLibre paint object, for categorized or graduated styling.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
A raw MapLibre paint object, for categorized or graduated styling.

oneOf.description: Use a named entry from the project's `symbology.json`.
oneOf.markdownDescription:
Use a named entry from the project's `symbology.json`.

stops.description: Low to high. The first and last labels mark the ends.
stops.markdownDescription: Low to high. The first and last labels mark the ends.

oneOf.description: Leave this layer out of the legend.
oneOf.markdownDescription: Leave this layer out of the legend.

legend.description: Explicit legend, for paint the legend can't read on its own.
legend.markdownDescription:
Explicit legend, for paint the legend can't read on its own.

text.description: Custom Label: your own words with columns mixed in, each column name in braces, e.g. `"{faa_id}: {name}, departures = {departures}"`. A feature without one of the columns shows nothing in its place. Used instead of `field`.
text.markdownDescription: Custom Label: your own words with columns mixed in, each column name in braces, e.g. `"{faa_id}: {name}, departures = {departures}"`. A feature without one of the columns shows nothing in its place. Used instead of `field`.

expression.description: MapLibre expression for the text. Wins over `field`. E.g. `["concat", ["get", "name"], " (", ["get", "code"], ")"]`.
expression.markdownDescription: MapLibre expression for the text. Wins over `field`. E.g. `["concat", ["get", "name"], " (", ["get", "code"], ")"]`.

bold.description: Bold text (Noto Sans Bold instead of Regular).
bold.markdownDescription:
Bold text (Noto Sans Bold instead of Regular).

Default: `false`

haloWidth.markdownDescription:
Outline width in px. 0 = none.

Default: `1`

minZoom.description: Zoom at which labels appear, so geometry can show first.
minZoom.markdownDescription:
Zoom at which labels appear, so geometry can show first.

Default: the layer's minZoom

anchor.description: Label position relative to its feature.
anchor.markdownDescription:
Label position relative to its feature.

Default: `"center"`

offset.description: How far a label at a corner sits from its feature, in px, across and up or down. Unset, it's as far as the text is tall. Has no effect when the label is centered.
offset.markdownDescription: How far a label at a corner sits from its feature, in px, across and up or down. Unset, it's as far as the text is tall. Has no effect when the label is centered.

allowOverlap.description: Draw every label, even where they collide.
allowOverlap.markdownDescription:
Draw every label, even where they collide.

Default: `false`

spacing.description: Line layers only: px between repeats of the label along a line.
spacing.markdownDescription:
Line layers only: px between repeats of the label along a line.

Default: `500`

label.description: Text labels for this layer, in Noto Sans (served by the basemap's glyphs URL, as OpenFreeMap styles do).
label.markdownDescription:

enabled.description: `false` turns the popup off but keeps the config.
enabled.markdownDescription:
`false` turns the popup off but keeps the config.

Default: `true`

position.description: Where the popup opens: a map corner, or `"feature"` next to the clicked spot.
position.markdownDescription:
Where the popup opens: a map corner, or `"feature"` next to the clicked spot.

Default: ui.popups.position

title.description: Column whose value is the popup's title, at the top of its content under the header bar (in templates that show one, as the standard ones do).
title.markdownDescription: Column whose value is the popup's title, at the top of its content under the header bar (in templates that show one, as the standard ones do).

header.description: Header bar text: your own words with columns mixed in, each column name in braces, e.g. `"{city} Airport"`, plus `{layerName}` and `{group}` for the layer's name and group. Without it, the header is the layer's name.
header.markdownDescription:
Header bar text: your own words with columns mixed in, each column name in braces, e.g. `"{city} Airport"`, plus `{layerName}` and `{group}` for the layer's name and group. Without it, the header is the layer's name.

Default: the layer name

fields.description: `{ "column": "Label" }`, shown in this order. Omit to show every property with raw column names.
fields.markdownDescription: `{ "column": "Label" }`, shown in this order. Omit to show every property with raw column names.
